categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 焦点集中在Agent的记忆、工具调用与安全评测，以及模型自我改进与蒸馏中的知识迁移。

articles.title: Language Models Learn to Improve Language Models
articles.zh: 语言模型学会改进语言模型
articles.summary: 如果你在关注模型自我进化这条路线，这篇讲的是让LLM自己当改进者、而不是被动接受蒸馏
articles.author: Minhua Lin, Zijun Wang 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate AI research, including language-model (LM) development, offering a potential path toward recursive self-improvement. However, turning experimental feedback into a learned ability to propose effective improvements across models faces two challenges. First, training such an ability with real feedback is expensive: reinforcement learning (RL) requires evaluating tens of thousands of proposals, each potentially requiring a full model-training run. Even at ten GPU-hours per run, reward collection alone would consume hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours, motivating a cheaper surrogate. Second, surrogate feedback can become unreliable as policy optimization favors overestimated proposals when the proposal distribution shifts. To address these challenges, we propose LM2LM, which trains LLMs with RL to generate effective LM improvement proposals. To provide scalable feedback, we use a research world model (RWM), a frozen LLM that predicts proposal gains from real experimental records provided in context, as the reward model for RL. To maintain feedback reliability, we periodically execute current-policy proposals ranked highly by the RWM and add their measured outcomes to its context. Across eight autoregressive and diffusion LM development environments, real-execution evaluations on held-out tasks show that LM2LM enables Qwen3.8-27B to outperform GPT-6-sol, even when GPT-6-sol is given 300 real experimental records in context, while requiring 33% lower data-generation cost. LM2LM also generalizes to a model family unseen during training.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用来把 AI 研究自动化，连语言模型（LM）开发也能掺一脚，这就可能走上一条“递归自我改进”的路。但真要把实验反馈变成一种学出来的本事，让模型能跨模型提出有效的改进方案，面前有两个坎儿。第一，用真实反馈来训练这种能力太贵了：强化学习（RL）得评估成千上万个提案，而每个提案背后可能都得完整跑一遍模型训练。哪怕每次训练只花 10 个 GPU 小时，光收集奖励也要几十万个 GPU 小时，所以大家自然想找个更便宜的“替身”来给反馈。第二，这种替代反馈（surrogate feedback）也可能不靠谱：当提案分布一变，策略优化（policy optimization）就会更偏爱那些被高估的提案。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了 LM2LM，用强化学习训练 LLM，让它生成有效的 LM 改进提案。为了提供能规模化的反馈，我们用一个研究世界模型（RWM）来当强化学习的奖励模型；它是个冻结的 LLM，会根据上下文里给出的真实实验记录，预测某个提案能带来多少收益。为了让反馈保持可靠，我们会定期把当前策略提出、并被 RWM 排在高位的提案真正执行一遍，再把实测结果加进它的上下文里。在八种自回归（autoregressive）和扩散（diffusion）语言模型开发环境里，我们在留出任务（held-out tasks）上做了真实执行评估，结果显示：LM2LM 能让 Qwen3.8-27B 超过 GPT-6-sol，哪怕给 GPT-6-sol 的上下文里塞了 300 条真实实验记录也一样；而且数据生成成本还低了 33%。LM2LM 还能泛化到训练时没见过的一个模型家族。

articles.title: Robust Function Calling for LLM Agents Under Interface Drift
articles.zh: 接口漂移下LLM Agent的鲁棒函数调用
articles.summary: 如果你的Agent靠调外部API吃饭，接口字段一改就全线崩溃，这篇正是冲着这个痛点去的
articles.author: Aniruddha Chattopadhyay, Kanishka Halder 等
articles.body: Tool-augmented language-model agents rely on interface text: tool descriptions, argument schemas, and the candidate tool list shown at inference time. These interfaces often change after deployment even when the underlying tool semantics remain fixed, creating a practical reliability problem for function-calling systems. We study this failure mode as interface drift and evaluate whether a lightweight, training-free repair layer can recover robustness without retraining the base model. Our method, SchemaShield-Lite, combines schema validation, candidate-set retry for missing tool names, and one-shot constrained repair. On Qwen3.5-9B, it raises DICE-300 accuracy from 0.717 to 0.813 and BFCL-200 accuracy from 0.580 to 0.805, recovering 19/22 and 33/45 drift-induced failures with no observed repair harms. Naive retry does not explain the gains. Ablations show that candidate-set drift, especially distractor tools, accounts for most observed damage, while description and schema edits alone are less harmful. The results position validation-and-repair as a practical robustness layer for deployed LLM-agent tool use.
articles.bodyZh: 带工具的语言模型智能体（tool-augmented language-model agents）干活时，很依赖界面上给的文字：工具描述（tool descriptions）、参数结构（argument schemas），还有推理时（inference time）展示出来的候选工具清单（candidate tool list）。这些界面在部署之后经常变，哪怕底层工具的实际功能没变，也会给函数调用系统（function-calling systems）带来很现实的可靠性问题。我们把这种失效模式叫作界面漂移（interface drift），并评估一个轻量、免训练（training-free）的修复层（repair layer）能不能在不重训基础模型的情况下把稳健性找回来。我们的方法 SchemaShield-Lite，把结构校验（schema validation）、工具名缺失时的候选集重试（candidate-set retry），以及一次性的约束修复（one-shot constrained repair）结合起来。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，它把 DICE-300 的准确率从 0.717 提到 0.813，把 BFCL-200 的准确率从 0.580 提到 0.805，分别救回了 19/22 和 33/45 个由漂移引发的失败，而且没观察到修复带来副作用（repair harms）。光靠简单重试（Naive retry）解释不了这些提升。消融实验（Ablations）显示，候选集漂移（candidate-set drift），尤其是干扰工具（distractor tools）这一块，造成了观察到的大部分损伤；相比之下，只改描述和参数结构，危害要小得多。这些结果表明，把校验和修复（validation-and-repair）作为已部署 LLM 智能体工具使用（LLM-agent tool use）中的实用稳健层，是站得住脚的。

articles.title: AgentOnto: Ontology-Guided LLM Agents for Enterprise Data Analytics
articles.zh: AgentOnto：本体引导的LLM Agent用于企业数据分析
articles.summary: 如果你在企业数据里做分析类Agent，本体约束可能是把"能查"变成"查得对"的关键一步
articles.author: Dayan Pan, Bincheng Zuo 等
articles.body: Enterprise data analysis requires agents to connect analytical requests with knowledge distributed across databases, business documents, and existing example tasks. Without an explicit representation of this knowledge, an agent may produce incorrect analytical results and cannot reliably incorporate feedback. We present AgentOnto, an ontology-guided LLM agent for enterprise data analytics. AgentOnto organizes heterogeneous enterprise knowledge into an ontology that directly guides analysis and incorporates confirmed feedback. Iterative Ontology Preparation further improves the ontology through self-generated analysis tasks. We evaluate AgentOnto on two public data sources. AgentOnto substantially outperforms representative methods, while module-level evaluations confirm the effectiveness of ontology construction, analysis, and updating. A real-world deployment further demonstrates its practical value in enterprise analytics. These results demonstrate that explicitly constructing, using, and updating enterprise knowledge supports reliable and adaptable data analysis.
articles.bodyZh: 企业数据分析这件事，需要智能体（agent）把分析需求跟散落在数据库、业务文档和已有示例任务里的知识串起来。要是这些知识没有被清清楚楚地表示出来，智能体就可能做出错误的分析结果，也没法稳定地吸收反馈。我们提出 AgentOnto，这是一个由本体（ontology）引导、面向企业数据分析的大语言模型（LLM）智能体。AgentOnto 会把异构的企业知识整理成一套本体，用这套本体直接指导分析，并把已经确认过的反馈纳入进来。迭代式本体准备（Iterative Ontology Preparation）还能通过自己生成分析任务，进一步完善这套本体。我们在两个公开数据源上评估了 AgentOnto。AgentOnto 明显优于一些有代表性的方法，模块级评估也证实了本体构建、分析和更新这几个部分确实有效。真实场景部署还进一步说明了它在企业分析里的实用价值。这些结果表明，把企业知识显式地构建出来、用起来、再持续更新，能够支撑可靠又灵活的数据分析。

articles.title: From Memory Hits to Answerable Evidence: Query-Conditioned Memory Compilation for Long-Term Agent Memory
articles.zh: 从检索命中到可作答证据：面向长期Agent记忆的查询条件化记忆编译
articles.summary: 如果你的Agent记忆只是向量召回一堆碎片却总也答不到点上，这篇的思路是把召回改成按查询编译成证据
articles.author: Shangze Li, Yanyu Yao 等
articles.body: Long-term agent memory requires recovering answer-relevant evidence dispersed across turns and sessions. Existing systems increasingly use structured memories and adaptive retrieval, yet often pass retrieved or expanded units directly to the reader, coupling memory addressing with evidence presentation and leaving the final context redundant or incomplete. To address this gap, we propose MemCompile, a query-conditioned evidence compilation framework for long-term conversational memory. Given a query, the Address Plane locates relevant support through compact source-linked descriptors and capacity-aware Cells, while a normalization boundary resolves heterogeneous retrieval hits to stable SourcePacket identities. Its Evidence Plane then allocates a bounded evidence budget across complementary packets, admits limited additional support, and renders the retained claims associated with each selected packet into an answer-ready context. MemCompile achieves 80.52% Judge Accuracy on LoCoMo and extends the empirical quality-cost Pareto frontier to a higher-quality regime. Its strong performance on LongMemEval-S further suggests that the benefits of query-conditioned compilation generalize across long-term conversational-memory benchmarks.
articles.bodyZh: 智能体的长期记忆，得能把散落在不同轮次、不同会话里、跟答案有关的证据重新找回来。现在不少系统越来越多地用结构化记忆（structured memories）和自适应检索（adaptive retrieval），但它们经常把检索到或扩展出来的内容直接塞给读取端（reader），等于把“记忆寻址”和“证据呈现”绑在一起，最后给出的上下文要么重复，要么不完整。为了解决这个问题，我们提出 MemCompile——一个面向长期对话记忆、由查询条件驱动（query-conditioned）的证据编译框架。拿到一个查询后，寻址层（Address Plane）会通过紧凑的、带来源链接的描述符（descriptors）和带容量感知的单元（Cells）来定位相关支撑内容；同时用归一化边界（normalization boundary）把各种异构的检索命中（heterogeneous retrieval hits）统一成稳定的源数据包标识（SourcePacket identities）。接着，证据层（Evidence Plane）会在互补的数据包之间分配一个有上限的证据预算（evidence budget），只接收少量额外支撑内容，并把每个被选中的数据包所对应的保留主张（claims）整理成可以直接拿来回答的上下文。MemCompile 在 LoCoMo 上的评审准确率（Judge Accuracy）达到 80.52%，还把实际测出的质量-成本帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier）推到了更高质量的区间。它在 LongMemEval-S 上的强劲表现也进一步说明，按查询条件做编译（query-conditioned compilation）带来的好处，能够推广到不同的长期对话记忆基准（benchmarks）上。

articles.title: Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT): Evidence-Based Text Generation via a Closed-Loop Retrieve--Reflect--Revise Pipeline on Edge LLMs
articles.zh: 自反思思维链（SRCoT）：边缘端LLM上基于"检索—反思—修订"闭环的证据式文本生成
articles.summary: 如果你要在端侧跑小模型又怕它张口就编，这个闭环能让它边写边自查证据，代价是多轮推理的延迟和算力
articles.author: Fabian Broszio, Michael Hoffmann 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. Local prototype runs on an Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory illustrate source-labeled documentation, explicit gap marking, and structured dispatch-style outputs. The traces also reveal provenance-assignment errors, incomplete evidence coverage, and unsafe assumptions that remain possible despite prompting constraints. These cases demonstrate report-level inspectability and local execution, not comparative superiority, hallucination reduction, clinical validity, or operational safety. The architecture separates retrieval and control from the model interface, but behavior across different models remains to be evaluated. SRCoT is a research proof of concept requiring human review, with its principal contribution lying in an inspectable control procedure rather than a new model.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能生成很流畅的内容，但这些内容可能没有来源支撑，也可能跟本地实际操作的约束打架。为此，我们提出一种叫自反思思维链（Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought, SRCoT）的模块化架构，把生成过程组织成一个闭环的“检索—反思—修订”流程（Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop）。SRCoT把环境状态、持久知识、积累经验、短期记忆分别放进带来源标签的存储库（provenance-labeled stores）里。BM25检索（BM25 retrieval）负责提供本地上下文；后面的轮次会把中间草稿、缺失信息标记、后续查询，以及可选的主张—证据对应关系（claim--evidence mappings）摆出来。这些中间产物会帮助系统决定：是继续检索、修订、澄清，还是干脆不回答。我们通过基于轨迹的定性案例研究（trace-based case studies）来考察这套架构，用了两个完全合成的场景（fully synthetic settings）：一个是紧急医疗服务（emergency medical services），另一个是慕尼黑模拟（Munich-Sim，一个应急行动模拟）。本地原型跑在一台苹果M4系列、128GB内存的笔记本（Apple M4-family laptop with 128 GB memory）上，展示了带来源标注的文档（source-labeled documentation）、明确的缺口标记（gap marking），以及结构化的调度式输出（dispatch-style outputs）。这些轨迹也暴露出一些问题：来源分配错误（provenance-assignment errors）、证据覆盖不完整（incomplete evidence coverage），还有就算加了提示约束，也仍可能出现的不安全假设（unsafe assumptions）。这些案例想说明的是报告级可检查性（report-level inspectability）和本地执行（local execution），并不是说它比别的方案更强（comparative superiority），也不是说它能减少幻觉（hallucination reduction）、具备临床有效性（clinical validity）或操作安全性（operational safety）。这套架构把检索和控制从模型接口（model interface）里分出来，但换不同模型后表现如何，还得再评估。SRCoT是一个研究概念验证（research proof of concept），需要人工审核；它最主要的贡献是一套可检查的控制流程（inspectable control procedure），而不是一个新模型。

articles.title: Inferring L1 Backgrounds from L2 English with LLM Token Probabilities
articles.zh: 用LLM的token概率从二语英语中推断母语背景
articles.summary: 如果你做用户画像或语言学习产品，这条得留意：模型的输出概率会泄露说话人的母语背景，也是一种隐私侧信道
articles.author: Ahmet Yavuz Uluslu, Mark Gales 等
articles.body: Native language identification (NLI) infers a non-native speaker's first language (L1) from their second language (L2) production. We investigate a token probability approach that scores each text sample as a continuation of a prompt prefix specifying a candidate L1, then predicts the candidate with the highest score. We evaluate our approach using Llama 3.1 8B and 70B on three datasets: TOEFL9, Write and Improve 2024, and BULATS-L1. We compare its performance with previous prompting-based classification approaches. Token-probability scoring substantially improves on direct classification, particularly with the 8B model, while the 70B model achieves state-of-the-art performance across all datasets. Our results indicate that pretrained LLMs' token probabilities contain information useful for distinguishing L1 backgrounds from L2 English production.
articles.bodyZh: 母语识别（Native language identification, NLI）就是根据一个人说或写的第二语言（L2），反推他的母语（L1）是什么。我们研究了一种“词元概率”（token probability）方法：把每个文本样本看成某个候选母语提示前缀（prompt prefix）的续写，然后给每个候选打分，最后选分数最高的那个作为预测结果。我们用 Llama 3.1 8B 和 70B 在三个数据集上做了评测：TOEFL9、Write and Improve 2024 和 BULATS-L1，并把它和之前那些基于提示的分类方法（prompting-based classification）做了比较。结果发现，用词元概率打分比直接分类提升很明显，尤其是 8B 模型；而 70B 模型在所有数据集上都达到了当前最好水平（state-of-the-art）。这说明，预训练大语言模型（LLM）的词元概率里，确实含有能区分不同母语背景的英语（L2）写作用的信息。

articles.title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
articles.zh: MobileInject：跨模态一致性注入下基于MLLM的手机Agent"推理到动作"安全评测
articles.summary: 如果你在做手机GUI Agent，这篇提醒你：注入内容只要在跨模态上"看着一致"，就能把Agent的推理一路带偏到危险操作
articles.author: Songping Wang, Peiyang Li 等
articles.body: Multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based mobile agents are rapidly evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that perceive, reason over, and act on smartphone environments. This capability also exposes a new security risk: adversaries can embed malicious objectives in cross-application mobile content and steer agent behavior through indirect multimodal injection. Although prompt injection has been studied in desktop and web settings, its cross-modal properties in mobile ecosystems remain poorly understood, and existing security analyses are still limited. To close this gap, we introduce MobileInject, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile agents against multimodal injection attacks and reasoning-to-action security risks. MobileInject provides a high-fidelity interactive mobile evaluation framework covering 11 scenarios, 9 security-risk categories, and 108 executable risk instances. It further introduces Cross-Modal Consistency Injection to exploit corroboration across modalities, two enhanced attack methods, Multi-Role Collaborative Deception and Reasoning-Camouflage Injection, to intensify trust manipulation and reasoning hijacking, and a Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework for fine-grained failure analysis. Systematic experiments show that mobile agents are broadly vulnerable to multimodal injection, and that many failures stem from reasoning hijacking at early stages. These findings establish MobileInject as a systematic cross-modal benchmark for studying and improving the security of mobile agents. Code release details are provided in the Appendix Open Science section.
articles.bodyZh: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的手机智能体，正快速从聊天助手变成能在手机环境里感知、推理并动手干活的自主系统。可这本事也带出一种新的安全风险：对手可以把恶意目标塞进跨应用的手机内容里，再通过间接多模态注入（indirect multimodal injection）把智能体的行为带偏。虽然提示注入（prompt injection）在桌面和网页场景里已经有人研究，但它在手机生态里的跨模态特性还没被真正搞明白，现有安全分析也还很有限。为了补上这个缺口，我们推出 MobileInject——首个用来评估手机智能体面对多模态注入攻击和“从推理到行动”安全风险的基准测试（benchmark）。MobileInject 提供一个高保真、可交互的手机评测框架，覆盖 11 个场景、9 类安全风险和 108 个可执行风险实例。它还引入跨模态一致性注入（Cross-Modal Consistency Injection），专门利用不同模态之间互相印证来下手；又加入两种增强攻击方法——多角色协作欺骗（Multi-Role Collaborative Deception）和推理伪装注入（Reasoning-Camouflage Injection），分别加强信任操纵和推理劫持；同时提出一个推理安全诊断框架（Reasoning Security Diagnosis Framework），用来做细粒度的失败分析。系统性实验显示，手机智能体普遍容易中多模态注入的招，而且很多失败其实源自早期阶段的推理被劫持。这些结果说明，MobileInject 可以作为一个系统性的跨模态基准，用来研究和提升手机智能体的安全性。代码发布细节放在附录的开放科学（Open Science）部分。

articles.title: SimOPD: Relational Knowledge Transfer for On-Policy Distillation
articles.zh: SimOPD：on-policy蒸馏中的关系知识迁移
articles.summary: 如果你在做蒸馏、只盯着让学生对齐teacher的token分布，这篇说真正该迁移的是样本之间的关系结构
articles.author: Kai Tang, Xing Zheng 等
articles.body: A key challenge in on-policy distillation (OPD) is extracting effective supervision from teacher knowledge. Supervision from token probabilities may underutilize internal knowledge, while direct hidden-state matching forces the student to shift to the teacher's feature space and complicates cross-architecture transfer. Inspired by contrastive learning's use of relationships between instances, we propose \textbf{SimOPD} to transfer teacher internal knowledge through response similarities. Specifically, SimOPD uses paired memory banks of student-generated responses to extract supervision from the teacher's internal representations as similarity distributions. The student then matches these distributions within its own representation space, retaining representational freedom and removing the need for cross-model projection. Extensive experiments show that SimOPD improves the overall average over the strongest baselines by up to 2.6 and 3.1 percentage points in same- and cross-architecture settings.
articles.bodyZh: 在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）里，一个关键难题是：怎么从教师模型的知识里提取出真正有效的监督信号。只靠 token 概率（token probabilities）来做监督，可能没把教师内部知识用充分；而直接做隐藏状态匹配（hidden-state matching），又会逼着学生模型把自己的特征空间（feature space）硬扭到教师那边去，跨架构迁移也更麻烦。受对比学习（contrastive learning）利用样本之间关系的启发，我们提出 **SimOPD**：通过回答之间的相似性来迁移教师的内部知识。具体说，SimOPD 用成对记忆库（paired memory banks）存学生生成的回答，从教师内部表示里提取相似性分布（similarity distributions）作为监督。然后学生模型在自己的表示空间（representation space）里去匹配这些分布，既保留表示上的自由度，也不需要跨模型投影（cross-model projection）。大量实验显示，在同架构和跨架构（same- and cross-architecture settings）下，SimOPD 相比最强基线，整体平均最多提升 2.6 和 3.1 个百分点。
